info.name: FOS – Food Ordering APIs
info.description:
HTTP APIs of the deployed FOS services (us-east-2). Run with the Collection Runner, or request by request from the top: create requests save `accountId`, `restaurantId`, `productId` and `orderId` for the ones after them. The Order folder runs the full saga and needs the Collection Runner.

Amounts are integer minor units (cents): 1450 = $14.50.

The URL variables come from each stack's `ApiUrl` output and change if a stack is destroyed and redeployed:
`aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name FosPayment --region us-east-2 --query "Stacks[0].Outputs"`

item.name: Payment
item.description: FosPayment HTTP API. Amounts are integer minor units (cents).

request.description: Creates an ACTIVE USD account with balance 0 and saves `accountId`.

exec: // A fresh referenceId per run. The duplicate request below reuses it.

request.description: Tops up the account. `referenceId` makes retries safe: each reference is applied once.
Replays the previous top-up. Expect `duplicate: true` and no balance change.
Up to 50 ledger entries, newest first.

item.name: Restaurant
item.description:
FosRestaurant HTTP API. There are no GET routes, so each write returns the full item.

Creating or updating a product publishes a `ProductChanged` event (fos.restaurant) to the bus, which routes it to the OrderEvents queue.

request.description: Creates a restaurant (status defaults to OPEN) and saves `restaurantId`.
While CLOSED, ConfirmOrder commands are rejected with RESTAURANT_CLOSED.
Adds a product ($14.50) and saves `productId`. Publishes ProductChanged v1.
Each update bumps `version` and publishes ProductChanged, so consumers can ignore stale events.
Orders containing this product are now rejected with PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE.
At least one of name or status is required.

item.name: Order (end-to-end saga)
item.description:
Runs the whole saga across all four stacks. **Use the Collection Runner on this folder**: it relies on `setNextRequest` to retry and poll. It creates its own account (balance 5000), restaurant and product (1450), so it doesn't depend on the other folders.

Flow: `POST /orders` → DebitPayment → PaymentCompleted → ConfirmOrder → RestaurantConfirmed → CONFIRMED. A rejection sends RefundPayment and ends CANCELLED; a failed debit ends FAILED.

Requires the outbox fix to be deployed to FosPayment and FosRestaurant.

request.description: Publishes ProductChanged, which fills Order's catalog copy a few seconds later.
